info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Models Management API
info.description: The Contribution Models Management API allows businesses to modify and manage their contribution models effectively. This operation enables authorized users to update specific attributes of existing contribution models, thereby ensuring alignment with evolving business strategies. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and fintech applications that require dynamic adjustments to contribution structures. It empowers organizations to maintain flexibility and responsiveness in their financial offerings.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the attributes of a specific contribution model identified by its unique ID. You can modify various fields to reflect the latest information or adjustments in the model's parameters.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the data to update the specified contribution model identified by RES-100045. The payload must conform to the structure defined in the schema to ensure a successful update.
